entities.name: Milica Pejanović-Đurišić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Milica Pejanović-Đurišić is a Montenegrin professor and politician who was Minister of Defense from 2012 to 2016. She is the first woman to hold this office. She has been serving as Ambassador of Montenegro to the United Nations since 2018.
